meta: Plan projects and milestones with AI, so a project doesn't slip just because the plan only had an end date.

muc.title: Late from day one
muc.text: Projects slip because the plan only lists the end date, and nobody writes down the steps in between.

muc.title: Work back from the deadline
muc.text: Give a chatbot the goal and deadline, and ask it to split the work into milestones counted back from the deadline to today.

muc.title: One person per milestone
muc.text: Each milestone needs an owner and a specific date. Ask AI for a table to paste into the team chat.

muc.title: Leave room for delays
muc.text: Ask AI which task is most likely to slip, then add a few buffer days. AI doesn't know the team's time off, so add that yourself.

muc.title: Four milestones this month
muc.text: Take something that must be done this month and ask AI to split it into four milestones with dates.

thu: Take something that must be done this month and ask AI to split it into 4 milestones with dates.
